author: CC
prose: The build inspector's trouble text says 'component_color at tools/base (proof test_active_page.py fingerprint matches working tree)' for a proof whose fingerprint does NOT match — the parenthetical is the finding's `about`, which is the expectation phrased positively (expected=True, actual=False). Same for 'crossing record 0 fingerprint verifies' on a record that fails to verify. Measured 2026-09-07: CC read 9 of 11 live troubles as green findings raised in error before reading the sieve source. A trouble is a diagnostic surface (Law 7: loud); a why that reads as its own opposite is quiet. Fix shape: _file_troubles_for_new_findings (inspector.py:3181) should render the finding as 'expected <about>; actual: not so — <reason>' or carry the finding's reason/values, not the bare about.
